visual_action: At a U.S. Air Force Academy event, JD Vance, wearing a suit, stands on a stage and greets a graduating cadet in uniform. After shaking hands, they do a chest bump which lifts the cadet off his feet. Both Vance and the cadet are smiling. Other cadets are on the stage behind them. In the background, another cadet stumbles and falls while walking away with her diploma folder.
